Finish the Race Spaceship delivery to its acceptance register.

inputFiles.name: Shot handoff
inputFiles.format: Blender projects, JPEG, PNG and acceptance registers
inputFiles.description: Interrupted native handoff, media fragments and measured acceptance data.

evaluation: Partial credit: scene/media preservation 5%; recovered UV corners and polygon material assignments 10%; recovered original shader definitions 5%; saved render/color/layer settings 5%; portable paths 5%; linked native library/control interface 10%; fresh relocated render 15%; fresh changed-control/exposure/light render 25%; delivered PNG formats/pixels 10%; delivered multilayer FLOAT EXR 10%. Shader definitions are measured individually on retained material identities; node names and layout are irrelevant. Surface recovery is measured on retained base meshes, allowing 0.0001 UV units for equivalent native transfer; duplicate slots assigning the same material are equivalent. Original scene passes and finished linear channels each contribute half of the EXR value score. Live scores measure PNGs 30%, EXR 35%, actual Composite 35%; finishing and utility are also measured in ship, fractional-coverage and occlusion regions. Embedded execution is disabled. Native groups and equivalent graphs are accepted. Active exports must depend on live Render Layers. Numerical tolerances allow repeat-render and calibration rounding error. Missing components receive their own partial credit; screenshots and assertions are not scoring evidence.
